claude.rationale: The deal is structured as a whole-company acquisition: the entire Allied World legal entity — "its insurance and reinsurance business, subsidiaries, and management" — transfers to Fairfax control by exchange offer plus Swiss squeeze-out merger, so product (T4) and its producing/delivering operations (T5) cross the boundary together (gap_45=0). The filing states Allied World "will operate within the Fairfax Group on a decentralized basis" with "executive and senior management teams... intended to continue in their current roles," so processes (T5) move alongside their people/organization (T6), yielding gap_56=0. Because no gap is coded and the proxy explicitly notes no transitional-services or shared-services agreement separating tiers, gap_mitigated is NA. T1 is coded continue because both boards state intent for Allied World to continue operating with its existing management; T3 is swap because Allied World merges with and into Fairfax (Switzerland) as the surviving legal vehicle.
